name: desktop_activity
description: Read the number of running agent sessions reported by ZCode.

evidence: Live ZCode 3.16.2 read: only runningAgentSessionCount is returned; the older runningRepoWikiTaskCount field is absent.

execution.expression: async () => { const activity = await window.zcode.getDesktopSessionActivity(); return {runningAgentSessionCount:activity.runningAgentSessionCount}; }
